Aids to Navigation - Lake Ontario - Humber Bay
Privately maintained orange and white mooring buoy with flashing amber light and radar reflector placed for the navigational season to mark the shipwreck "Lyman Davis" at 43 36.132N 079 24.996W.
                                                    Cancels NW-C-1423-26
